params.body:
Shane on staging (15 September 2026): "foto's sorteren door te slepen werkt nog niet zo vlot, zou intuïtiever moeten, en ook vermelden", tiles with an empty grey circle where the grip icon should be, and "kopieën verwijderen is niet stabiel". Builds on PR 464 (drag by grip or photo, saved via `changeImageOrder`).

## What changed for the dealer

**It says how it works.** One quiet line above each grid: "Sleep een foto om de volgorde te wijzigen. De eerste foto is de hoofdfoto." (nl/fr/en/de/es), and a small "Hoofdfoto" chip on the first tile. The chip is in every tile and the stylesheet shows it on `li:first-child` only, so it follows the order after a drag without a script moving it. The lead line under the section title and this hint may run to 95ch from 1024px (they wrapped at 62ch on a desktop).

**The drag feels like a drag** (`resources/js/sortable.js`, rewritten). Until now the real element jumped from slot to slot in the DOM with no transition and nothing said where it would land. Now:
- pointer down + 6px lifts the tile: it becomes a fixed card under the pointer (scale 1.03, shadow, `.ui-sorting`), body cursor `grabbing`;
- a dashed placeholder of the same size stays at the origin and moves between the tiles with the pointer (left half of a tile is before, right half after; top/bottom in a list);
- the other tiles shift in 120 ms via FLIP, none under `prefers-reduced-motion`;
- the page scrolls when the pointer nears the top or bottom edge;
- touch: 250 ms hold starts the drag, a swipe before that scrolls as before; `touchmove` is blocked only while a drag is active; the ⋯ sheet keeps "Verplaats naar voren/achteren";
- drop saves (one PUT with the ids in order), `ui.notify('Volgorde bewaard')`; when the save fails the tiles go back in the order from before the drag (`ui.before`) with a red notify; Escape cancels and says "Volgorde niet gewijzigd". A plain click on the photo still opens the lightbox.

**Grip icon that cannot go missing.** The grip was `<i class="fas fa-grip-vertical">`, a Font Awesome rule inside the purged theme stylesheet (30 days of `Cache-Control` on `/template/css`). It is now an inline SVG (`photos/grip.blade.php`, six dots) in both tile partials; no font subset or cached stylesheet can drop it.

**Deleting platform copies.** The server side was fine (soft delete, original untouched, the poll never renders a trashed row). What made it "not stable": the bulk buttons on the photo tab first save the sheet's draft (`vehicle.tempUpdate('#vehicle-update-form', ...)`) and only then run the action.
- On the Livewire sheet there is no classic form, so that post arrived **empty**, and `OwnStockController::tempUpdate` read it as `available_on_stocklist = 0`, `showroom_vehicle = 0`, inspection dates `null`: deleting a copy quietly took the vehicle off Stocklist. An empty draft now writes nothing (server guard) and the script posts no draft when the form is not on the page.
- A failed draft save (a 500 on a messy field, an outbound call the seal refuses on staging) blocked the action silently; it no longer does (the photos save themselves), and a failed delete now says "De foto is niet verwijderd. Probeer het opnieuw."

Finding: `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-kopie-verwijderen-haalde-wagen-van-stocklist.md`. Rule R S1-6.33 extended with the hint, the chip, the drag behaviour and the SVG grip.

## Tests

- `PhotoReorderTest` extended: hint above both grids, chip in every tile, SVG grip with six dots and no `fa-grip-vertical`, the new translation keys in five languages, the sortable's threshold/hold/shift/placeholder/Escape/touch contract, `ui.before` restore on a failed save, the CSS for lift, placeholder, chip and the 95ch lead.
- `PlatformCopyDeleteTest` (new): delete one copy → soft-deleted, files gone, original intact, gallery and poll payload exclude it; bulk delete of two of three; another dealer refused; an empty draft post leaves sharing and dates untouched (fails on main); the script never lets the draft or a failure block a delete silently.
- Browser run (puppeteer, headless Chrome, local seed at 1440 and 390): drag tile 3 → position 1 by the photo: lifted fixed tile, placeholder at index 0, one PUT `order=575441,575439,575440,...`, chip on the new first tile, "Volgorde bewaard", order survives a reload, Escape restores and sends no PUT, plain click opens the lightbox, the 390 sheet shows the two move rows; touch: a swipe does not lift, a 320 ms hold lifts and the drag saves. There is no Playwright harness in the repo, so this run is not committed.

`vendor/bin/phpunit --filter 'Photo|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|CompiledViews|BuildContract|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|LanguageParity|FrenchTranslations'`: OK (123 tests, 1780 assertions, 1 incomplete).

## Screenshots

`.playwright-mcp/photo-drag-feel/drag-mid-1440.png` (lifted tile, dashed placeholder at position 1, neighbours shifted), `drag-after-1440.png` (new order, "Hoofdfoto" chip on the first tile, "Volgorde bewaard"), `sheet-390.png` (⋯ sheet with "Verplaats naar voren/achteren"), `grid-390.png`.

## Open

Whether the sheet's draft should still be saved before a photo action at all is a question for Ilse: the photo actions no longer reload the page, so the reason for it is gone. This PR only makes it harmless.
params.title: Photo reorder that says how it works, and copies that delete cleanly
